After a few hours of removing the second pimple patch my pimple turned very red and it looked like there was bright red wound on my face. I have skin that i'd think is hard to please but these work so well for me. I love them and will swear by them now. within 6 hours these patches pull the gunk out of your pimple and swelling subsides. it's unbelievable like magic.

I've tried these and two other main competitors. I have found these do not work unless it's right on a developed pimple. There is one brand (ZS) that can pull oil from an area that is heavy in oil and I can tell a pimple WILL form if I don't dry the area out a bit. I have found only the ZS brand to work on developed pimples both large and small as well as high oil areas. these patches along with another competitor never seem to draw oil unless, as I stated couple times, there is a developed pimple. So for me these are far inferior than my personal preferred brand. I haven't found these to be useful in multiple scenarios which is a big downside for me considering the cost isn't too competitive compared to the others. I know some people have great success with these and if you suffer from regular breakouts versus more combo skin type issues where you have a lot of oil that you are trying to control I might try these

These patches leave an alarming amount of adhesive residue on the skin after removal. It is so difficult to scrub off with facial cleanser I had to use rubbing alcohol. avis.titre: Duo sample kit has no labels for day vs night
avis.texte: This was the first time I've tried the patches and the sample kit, which is really pretty handy or should be, has two sets of patches inside. The problem is I didn't know which ones were for night and which ones were for day. I may have used the wrong ones at night and I feel that it made my gigantic pimple even bigger rather than draining it. Still, after a few days the problem resolved pretty well, so I will use these again. But I loved the way the patches lay very flat and the fact that you can put makeup over them and they're nearly invisible. If I knew for sure which patch was for day vs night, I would give this five stars. Some type of labeling or just a guide on the box would be helpful. One set of patches had a smaller ring visible inside the perimeter.
Everyone should be using these. Put the dot on your zit at night and wake up the next morning. Remove the patch and waa-laa,...gone.

This product is simply the best, works great, and always have a supply on hand!

So as someone who gets a lot of whiteheads and acne, I've tried many pimple patches. I've seen this brand and its reviews everywhere so I gave it a try. I put it on after I did my night routine and slept with them, then took it off the next morning. Before taking it off, I noticed that the patches were filled with what seemed to be pimple gunk or puss and I was thinking "yes ! it worked" but when I pulled off the patch the pimple was still there and it was still kind of full of puss. I was thinking maybe I need to do multiple patches one on but still some pimple didn't go away. But I will say that the pimple irritation, swelling, and bump had gone down and there is one set of patches that are meant to not be seen, and it really makes it look like there's no patch on your face. Overall, I would say that you have to keep using multiple on one pimple to get the effect but they do calm down your pimples and the patches look invisible to me. Mind you, there are also patches in the box that are not meant to look invisible, they're just regular patches.

The mighty patch is strong to wear day and night. You can sleep on it. The invisible patch really hides your pimple which is perfect when you're self-conscious about it. I like to use the routine so the pimple doesn't leave a scar or dark spots. I'd recommend it!
